description: This file defines data structures, function prototypes, and constants related to event handling in the Android telephony RIL (Radio Interface Layer). It includes definitions for ril_event structures, callback types, and functions for initializing, setting, adding, deleting, and looping over ril events.

methods.name: ril_event_init
methods.description: Initializes internal data structures for ril_event management.

methods.name: ril_event_set
methods.description: Configures a ril_event with specified parameters such as file descriptor, persistence, callback, and user data.

methods.name: ril_event_add
methods.description: Adds a ril_event to the watch list for event monitoring.

methods.name: ril_timer_add
methods.description: Adds a timer ril_event with a specified timeout.

methods.name: ril_event_del
methods.description: Removes a ril_event from the watch list.

methods.name: ril_event_loop
methods.description: Runs the event loop to process ril_events.
